"'''Booombaaa Booombaa Bombashella'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] written by a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Unidentified Gungan master songwriter|master songwriter]]. It was a number one [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] hit for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[entertainer]] [[Anj'a]], who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="SWG" /> and the only release by a non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] artist to top the charts during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Slughthrowers2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|Her]] performance of the song at the [[Grand Theater of Vreni Island|outdoor theater]] at [[Vreni Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was depicted in the painting ''[[Intense Performer]]''.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The only mention of "Booombaaa Booombaa Bombashella" was in the description of the painting ''Intense Performer'', which appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. The painting and its description are the creation of the player Anj'a, who won a contest in [[2010]] to have their painting and its history added to the game. In [[2014]], the song was mentioned in the second installment of ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'', an article written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]] and published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]].
